name: vectorcraft-mcp-server
description: MCP server for VectorCraft: vectorize images, convert between 20 vector and raster formats, design with shapes, text, effects and charts, recolor and export artwork with VectorCraft's own engine, from Claude (Windows, macOS, Linux).

scripts.pack:mcpb: npm run build && npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcpb pack . vectorcraft-mcp-server.mcpb

author: Jhon Supelano (https://github.com/jhonsu01)

codex.shortDescription: Vectorize images and create vector art with your local VectorCraft
defaultPrompt: Vectorize this logo to SVG with clean shapes
Convert these AI and EPS files to SVG and PDF
Create a bar chart as an SVG from this data
